text_block_list.text: A fan letter arrives for Уиннинг Тикит.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa! For me? A fan letter?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
That means there's someone out there
giving me
their support!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Sorry—I just don't know how to put this
feeling
into words!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So I guess my body kinda started
expressing itself
on its own!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll work even harder now! I need
to, for
the people out there putting their
hope in me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I promise I'll give them something back! I'll do it by winning races!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: And to do that, I'll have to...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna go run!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: WOO HOO! I'm gonna run my socks off!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Before I can stop her, she dashes out
toward the
twilit track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
